description: Move the GitHub-readable documentation tree from .oh/docs to root docs while preserving the external rendered-site boundary and the .oh payload safety boundary.

userStories.title: Relocate documentation and repair internal links
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the documentation tree at the project root so GitHub and normal repository tooling discover it at the conventional docs/ path without broken links.
acceptanceCriteria: Every tracked file matching .oh/docs/** exists at the same relative path below docs/**
.oh/docs/ is absent and no compatibility symlink or duplicate tree is created
Repository-relative Markdown links and repository-location examples resolve from the new docs/ locations
Rendered-site /docs/... links and unrelated external documentation URLs remain external links
docs/ contains the migrated README.md and existing _category_.json metadata but no Docusaurus package, config, sidebar, or build script
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Repoint live guidance and catalog consumers
userStories.description: As an operator, I want commands, catalog output, installation guidance, skills, and repository maps to name root docs so every current read path remains usable after the move.
acceptanceCriteria: Root guidance, issue templates, Makefile output, devcontainer messages, and active scripts use docs/... for repository documentation
Harness, runtime, and tool catalog docsPath values and their assertions use root-relative docs/... paths and resolve to existing files
Active skills, wiki entries, templates, and current task requirements use the new path while immutable and historical records remain classified
A tracked-reference audit reports no unexplained active .oh/docs references
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Make payload and regression contracts match the root move
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the CLI payload and regression guards to state the new ownership boundary so an update cannot silently vendor or overwrite a project's root documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: .oh/manifest.json no longer declares docs/** and remains relative to .oh/ with patches/** excluded
oh init and oh update tests prove root docs are not copied through the .oh payload and existing target root docs are preserved
Catalog, manifest, vendor, init, and update tests pass with the new root-docs boundary
docs-build-fast-path.sh guards root docs as Markdown/category-metadata only and retains the external-site invariant
Related lifecycle, image, Slack, stale-reference, payload, and CI-path guards point at root docs; ci-harness.yml runs for docs/**
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Align durable knowledge and complete verification
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want durable knowledge and benchmark expectations to describe the new docs location so future agents do not rediscover the old layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Affected current wiki entries use root docs/ paths, source-backed claims, relevant relationships, and See Also navigation; raw snapshots remain unchanged
.oh/skills/wiki/corpus/README.md is refreshed and the wiki README index probe passes
Capability orientation tasks and current fixtures expect root docs/ paths, and eval results are refreshed by the runner
Focused link/reference checks, relevant CLI/script tests, docs and payload probes, and full applicable test/typecheck commands pass
.oh/tasks/docs-project-root/evidence.md is committed before PR promotion and records divergence and unverified items
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
